# svg-air-vehicles adaptations

Source: https://github.com/jhwohlgemuth/svg-air-vehicles

Pinned revision: `c559a5094af53a5add2125179685493aa51c3f6c`

Copyright (c) 2015 Jason Wohlgemuth. Licensed under MIT; licence and copyright
notice are preserved in `LICENSE`. Retain that notice when distributing copies.

Adapted artwork: B-2 and KC-135 inline SVGs from `air-vehicles.html`, selected
by the explicit `B-2 air-vehicle` and `KC-135 air-vehicle` classes. Extracted
standalone vectors are saved in `silhouettes/`; no page scripts are executed.

Changes: grey palette, standalone accessible wrapper, fitted framing and source
metadata. Vector coordinates and drawing order are retained. These terms do not
relicense unrelated artwork in the collection.

The KC-135 reference identifies the aircraft family only. It does not explicitly
identify an R/T engine subtype and must not be treated as a verified subtype
drawing. These are community SVG references, not manufacturer drawings.
